description: Pinned EMBER2024 PE train zips for the malware engine (docs/design/malware-engine-v1.md §3.7, §4.2, §9 step 7). Fetched and verified by data/scripts/fetch_ember2024.py.
pin_reason: Newest dataset revision on 2026-11-26 (2025-08-22), more than two weeks old. Only the Win32, Win64 and Dot_Net train zips were approved by the owner on 2026-11-26.
license_source: dataset card metadata (license: apache-2.0) and the EMBER2024 code repository
citation: Joyce et al., "EMBER2024 - A Benchmark Dataset for Holistic Evaluation of Malware Classifiers", KDD 2025, DOI 10.1145/3711896.3737431
sha256_source: Hugging Face LFS oid (SHA-256) and size for each file at the pinned revision, from /api/datasets/joyce8/EMBER2024/tree/<revision>; each file is hashed locally on download and must match
not_downloaded: Every other file of the repository, including the test zips, challenge.zip and the APK, ELF and PDF zips. thrember download_dataset and download_models are never used.
